title: Anthropic faces leak of Claude Fable 5 system prompt #anthropic #claudefable5 #
description: Anthropic leaked the full system prompt for Claude Fable 5, revealing a 120,000-character instruction set that defines how Claude thinks, plans, uses tools, and behaves as an AI agent. This prompt is far more than a simple ChatGPT input; it represents a sophisticated framework guiding Claude’s advanced capabilities. The leak highlights that the true innovation in AI performance lies not just in the model itself, but in the structure of its instruction system. Applying similar frameworks to more affordable models like GLM, Kimi, or DeepSeek can significantly enhance their outputs without needing larger, costlier architectures. Understanding and leveraging these complex instruction systems offers a strategic advantage in AI development, enabling wider access to powerful AI capabilities and shifting focus from pure model size to smarter prompt engineering. #Anthropic #ClaudeFable5 #AIpromptengineering #ArtificialIntelligence #LanguageModels #GLM #KimiAI #DeepSeek #AIAgents #PromptEngineering #MachineLearning #AIframework #TechInnovation #AIResearch #U100X
